items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: What the young man is doing now, Ed Dennis, I mean I have about four or five hundred that I’ve always had.

ctx.x: Records and sessions, different records. We should have at least that. What the young man is doing now, Ed Dennis, I mean I have about four or five hundred that I’ve always had.
